tasks.subject: Task 1: Skelet src-tauri a okno na dashboard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** src-tauri se zbuildi a otevre okno s dashboardem z rucne spusteneho demona.

**Files:**
- src-tauri/Cargo.toml
- src-tauri/Cargo.lock
- src-tauri/build.rs
- src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
- src-tauri/icons/32x32.png
- src-tauri/icons/128x128.png
- src-tauri/src/main.rs
- src-tauri/src/ui.rs
- .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cargo build projde
- cargo test projde (5 testů titulku)
- okno otevre URL a stranka ma 9 karet (Docker pri 1180x820 pod foldem, po zvetseni videt)
- src-tauri/target ani src-tauri/gen nejsou v gitu
- src-tauri/Cargo.lock je v gitu

**Verify:** cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src-tauri/Cargo.toml", "src-tauri/Cargo.lock", "src-tauri/build.rs", "src-tauri/tauri.conf.json", "src-tauri/icons/32x32.png", "src-tauri/icons/128x128.png", "src-tauri/src/main.rs", "src-tauri/src/ui.rs", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cargo build projde", "cargo test projde (5 testů titulku)", "okno otevre URL a stranka ma 9 karet (Docker pri 1180x820 pod foldem, po zvetseni videt)", "src-tauri/target ani src-tauri/gen nejsou v gitu", "src-tauri/Cargo.lock je v gitu"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Sidecar — spuštění, readiness, PDEATHSIG
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Aplikace spusti demona, kdyz 8430 neposloucha; PDEATHSIG zabiji vlastneneho demona pri padu Tauri.

**Files:**
- src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs
- src-tauri/src/main.rs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- bez demona aplikace spusti python3 -m sysmon_app a ceka na 8430
- s bezicim demonem nespusti druhy
- kill -9 Tauri -> port volny (5x)
- cizi demon prezije ukonceni aplikace
- unit test daemon_dir_ok

**Verify:** cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml + lifecycle skript

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs", "src-tauri/src/main.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml + lifecycle skript", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bez demona aplikace spusti python3 -m sysmon_app a ceka na 8430", "s bezicim demonem nespusti druhy", "kill -9 Tauri -> port volny (5x)", "cizi demon prezije ukonceni aplikace", "unit test daemon_dir_ok"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Dozor — restart, exit code 2, chybový dialog
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pad vlastneneho demona spusti max 3 restarty (1/2/4 s), pak dialog; rc=2 se nerestartuje.

**Files:**
- src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs
- src-tauri/src/ui.rs
- src-tauri/src/main.rs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- unit testy backoff_for a should_restart
- SIGKILL -> novy demon do ~2 s
- rc=2 -> zadny restart, dialog se stderr
- po trech padech dialog Zkusit znovu/Ukoncit

**Verify:** cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml + SIGKILL + presunuty build

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs", "src-tauri/src/ui.rs", "src-tauri/src/main.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml + SIGKILL + presunuty build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["unit testy backoff_for a should_restart", "SIGKILL -> novy demon do ~2 s", "rc=2 -> zadny restart, dialog se stderr", "po trech padech dialog Zkusit znovu/Ukoncit"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Tray, zavření do traye a ukončení
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tray ikona s menu, zavreni okna schova, ukonceni zastavi vlastneneho demona.

**Files:**
- src-tauri/src/ui.rs
- src-tauri/src/main.rs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- tray ikona v KDE panelu
- levy klik a Otevrit dashboard okno zviditelni
- zavreni okna proces neukonci
- Ukoncit zastavi aplikaci i demona; 8430 volny
- bez traye se zavreni chova jako ukonceni

**Verify:** cargo test + rucni KDE klikani + pgrep/ss

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src-tauri/src/ui.rs", "src-tauri/src/main.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test + rucni KDE klikani + pgrep/ss", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tray ikona v KDE panelu", "levy klik a Otevrit dashboard okno zviditelni", "zavreni okna proces neukonci", "Ukoncit zastavi aplikaci i demona; 8430 volny", "bez traye se zavreni chova jako ukonceni"]}
```
